evals.prompt: Write a PRFAQ for an AI-powered contract review tool aimed at in-house legal teams at mid-market companies. The problem: legal teams spend 60% of their time on low-complexity contract review that blocks deal closure.
assertions: Press release contains all blocks: headline, sub-headline, problem paragraph, solution paragraph, leadership quote, customer quote, call to action
The headline names the product and a customer benefit — not a category claim like 'launches AI-powered platform'
The problem paragraph is in the customer's words with no industry jargon
The solution paragraph names a mechanism, not just 'uses AI'
The leadership quote is attributed to a role (not a placeholder name) and states a strategic rationale
An adoption hypothesis names a first-success event that is a customer action, observable within a session — not 'signs up', 'completes onboarding', or a team action like 'launch'
Customer FAQ has 3-5 questions and at least one answer concedes a real trade-off
Internal FAQ names the riskiest assumption with a test, the hardest technical problem, a concrete acquisition path, and a kill condition
The internal-FAQ success metric counts the first-success event, not a vanity metric
No acceptance criteria, API shapes, or backlog items appear anywhere
The output ends with a hand-off pointing to prd-draft or business-case
